_note: R60 legacy bonuses, branch points and endings. All amounts and names [invented, approved R60 proposal].

bonuses.name: +5% XP in one skill chosen at creation
Start knowing the Dwarfhold road (Dwarfhold on the map, Highlands travel ×1.05)
Quickened Years: +5% game speed (within the speed cap)

branches.name: The Highland Clans
branches.text: Clan Rowan asks you to stand with them against House Crane. Crane's heir offers coin to look the other way.

b.name: Take Crane's coin
b.text: 200 coin and the Highland market; Rowan turns cold

branches.name: Rogues or Church
branches.text: The Rogues and the Church both want your family's loyalty. Whoever reaches the top rank first decides.

a.name: Side with the Rogues
a.text: Thief and Spy line; +5% item sales

branches.name: Collegium or the Crone
branches.text: The Collegium calls the Crone a menace; the Crone calls the Collegium thieves of old lore.

b.name: Stand with the Crone
b.text: Crone's Ward; +1 herb remedy a year

branches.name: Fishers or Convoys
branches.text: Saltmere's fishers and the convoy merchants fight over the quay.

branches.name: The Sealed Gate
branches.text: The Rune-Sealed Gate can be opened to the deep halls, or kept sealed as the Thanes ask.

b.name: Keep it sealed
b.text: A Thane gift (150 coin) + no raids for a year

branches.name: The Wolf King
branches.text: The Lodge hunt has the Wolf King at bay. The bounty hunters want the pelt; the Lodge would let him go.

endings.name: The Lamp-Keepers
endings.text: Their word held and their lamps burned; the Church still names them in the litany.

endings.name: Keepers of the Hold
endings.text: They kept their oaths and the old rites both, and the Hold kept them.

endings.name: The Zealous House
endings.text: Fervent and feared, they lit pyres more often than lamps.

endings.name: The Drowned Bargain
endings.text: They traded promises for power, and the tide came to collect.
